description:
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing the noncreature artifact, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
The Constructs enter the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Construct, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the second Intruder Alarm trigger from step 2, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
